notes.title: Maximum Velocity Update 0.4.0.1
notes.notes:
Wow, it’s been a while! We know it’s been over a year since our last update, and we truly appreciate your patience and support during that time. We've been hard at work behind the scenes, and we're thrilled to finally share what we've been cooking up!

This update brings exciting changes, fixes, and improvements that we hope you'll love. We're excited to get back on track and keep the updates flowing more regularly from here on out.

Let's dive into what's new!

We’re excited to introduce Ironwood — a brand-new location for players to explore!  Whether you're new to the game or a long-time player, Ironwood offers fresh adventures, stunning scenery, and new challenges to uncover. We can’t wait to see what you discover in this exciting new area!

Ironwood isn’t a place of serene beauty; it’s a dirty city, a gritty, bustling urban sprawl where the less fortunate fight to survive. The city is filled with narrow alleyways, makeshift homes, and hidden stories of hardship and resilience, where every corner tells a tale of struggle and survival.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280036/790d9f4552398abb89059d042d3b8ccce6e675eb.jpg

Time Trials - Get ready for a new challenge — Time Trials are here! In this new Activity, you'll race against the clock, pushing your skills to the limit. Each trial has three tiers of completion times: Bronze, Silver, and the ultimate challenge, Gold.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280036/efc0cbbbf30a5e90fe5bc81f8536472f62beaa36.gif

Your goal? Master the course, refine your speed, and beat your own best times to climb the ranks. Whether you're chasing precision movement or shaving off those last few seconds, Time Trials offer endless replay ability and room to improve.

Introducing Drive School! This high-stakes Activity challenges you to complete a driving course as quickly as possible while avoiding all cones along the way.

Speed alone won’t get you far — you’ll need to showcase perfect control and precision. Hitting even one cone means you fail the course, so every move must be calculated. The faster you go, the harder it gets, but a single mistake could cost you the win!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280036/e44d9d7b525d58e4526b56c4d343c130a1c13b06.gif

Test your driving skills, race against the clock, and prove you’ve got what it takes to claim the Gold!

Welcome to Drift Activity This Activity is all about style, precision, and scoring big. Your goal? Drift through the checkpoints, chaining together perfect drifts to rack up points and earn Bronze, Silver, or Gold!

To score the highest, you’ll need to hit the perfect angles on each drift. The more flawless your angles, the more points you’ll earn! But be careful — hitting any objects will cause you to lose valuable points, so stay sharp and avoid collisions. 

Look out for Drift Hittables, special objects scattered around the course that’ll give you bonus points when hit, as well as Time Multipliers that can boost your score even further. The key is to chain your drifts, connect your angles, and master the track for a perfect run!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280036/04dc9c0cd9a2ece47b738f88d233bd21e47b6706.gif

Are you ready to drift your way to the top and claim Gold? Let the drifting begin!

Introducing Gas Stations! While free roaming, your gas will slowly decrease over time. If you run out of gas, your car will blow up, and you’ll lose some of your Bits — so it's important to keep your fuel in check. To avoid this, make sure to stop by a Gas Station and spend your Bits to refill your tank and heal your car.

Keep an eye on your fuel levels, as running out means losing some of your hard-earned Bits. Gas Stations are your key to staying in the game, helping you stay prepared and ready for whatever comes next.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280036/969e65a8776cb27d47f05964c3762303b180096f.gif

Refuel, stay vigilant, and keep your car in top condition before heading back out on your journey! 

New Feature: Consumables at Gas Stations!
 
We’re adding a brand-new feature to Gas Stations: the ability to purchase Consumables that give you powerful buffs! To start, we’re keeping it simple with just a couple of options, but they’ll help you get ahead in the game.

Choco Bits: Double your Bits earnings for a limited time!
XPower Drink: Boost your XP by 2X for a limited time!

To use them, simply stop by a Gas Station, buy your consumable, and then head into your inventory to activate it. These buffs will give you a temporary edge, so use them wisely to maximize your progress.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280036/60f19dc4d4e74f8745b89068e25d921c522dee65.gif

Stay tuned for more consumables to be added in the future — we’re just getting started!

Biggy Map Improvements: We’ve made it easier than ever to navigate and plan your next adventure. Now, when you click on icons on the map, you can see exactly what loot and times are available for activities. No more guessing — everything you need is right at your fingertips!

New Traction Stat: We've introduced a new stat — Traction! Different wheels will now affect how your car handles. For example, less traction will make it easier to drift, while more traction will give you better control. Experiment with different setups to find the perfect balance for your driving style!
 
Shop Changes & Streamlined Experience! 

We’ve made some changes to improve your in-game experience and make it easier to find what you need. The Wheel Shop has been removed and is now part of the Performance Shop!

We found that having too many shops cluttered the experience, so we’ve simplified things. Now, you can equip all your car's stats and upgrades, including wheels, in one convenient place — the Performance Shop. This makes it easier to find and customize everything you need without hunting through multiple shops.

Race Overhaul: Smarter AI & Better Rewards!

We’ve made some major improvements to the racing experience to make it more challenging and rewarding! The AI has been significantly upgraded, making them smarter, faster, and more competitive than ever before. Get ready for a true test of your skills as you race against these improved opponents!

But that’s not all — racing on harder difficulty levels now rewards you with more XP and Bits, so the challenge is well worth it. Plus, you’ll gain loot after every race, giving you valuable items to improve your car.

With these updates, racing is now a key part of car progression, making every race an opportunity to upgrade and enhance your ride. Race hard, earn big, and level up your car like never before.

Bug Fixes & Ongoing Improvements

Since our last update, we’ve addressed many bug fixes to improve your gameplay experience. However, bugs can sometimes slip through the cracks, so we ask that you stay vigilant and let us know if you encounter any issues.

If you spot a bug, please report it to us via our Discord or the Steam Discussion page. We take this very seriously and are committed to making sure you have a smooth, enjoyable experience with no bugs getting in the way of your fun.

Thanks for helping us keep the game clean and fun for everyone! Your feedback is essential to making the game better.

In Other News:
We’ve heard your feedback about loading times and are currently investigating ways to improve them. Our goal is to get those times down so you can jump into the action faster!
What’s Next? 
We’re hard at work on even more exciting updates for you! Our team is expanding the city, adding more races, and new activities, and crafting something top-secret that we can’t wait to reveal. It’s all hush-hush for now, but trust us — you’ll want to stay tuned! 
In the meantime, we hope you’ve been enjoying all the new features we’ve just introduced. Now, get out there and make the most of everything the game has to offer! The journey is just getting started.

notes.title: Maximum Velocity Update 0.1.6.8
notes.notes:
Features added
Drifting Feature: We're thrilled to introduce the all-new drifting feature to the game. Players can now drift through curves and turns, bringing an exciting twist to the gameplay.
Crafting Debut: We are thrilled to present the first edition of our crafting system.
Notification system: When hitting destructibles you will now see the loot you get for crafting.  
Effect Shops: We're thrilled to introduce the first version of Effect Shops to the game. These shops offer a plethora of options for customizing your gameplay experience.
Banner Customization: Explore an array of unique banners, each with its own style and flair, allowing you to personalize your in-game identity.
Icon Customization: Dive into the world of icons, where you can choose from a diverse range of symbols and designs to represent your character.
Underglow Customization: Make your mark on the race by customizing your vehicle's underglow with a variety of captivating and colorful options.
Boost Flames: Enhance the speed and style of your rides with customizable boost flames, adding an extra layer of visual excitement to your races.
Smoke Visuals Revamp: completely overhauled smoke visuals.
City Transformation: In this monumental update, we've completely transformed the city within the game. The city will now have layers and will be more fun to explore. 
Performance Improvements: Improved significant performance in this update, ensuring a smoother and more responsive gaming experience.
Chase Game Mode Improvements: we introduce a dynamic map scaling feature for the Chase Mode. Now, the size and complexity of chase maps will adapt to the number of players in the game. 
Overlap Visuals: Updated the visuals of the overlaps, so it’s easier for the players to see them.
Race Ai Revamped: We've undertaken a significant transformation of our Race AI, even more improvements coming soon.
Soft Landing: Improved landing when taking large jumps
Active Respawn: improved respawn, you can now manually trigger a respawn by pressing the flip button in races.
Race Progress: The race progress is now visible on the side of the HUD while racing.
Race distance: Race UI now displays the distance separating racers.  
Two new races: two thrilling new races set in the slums, Winding Up, Burning Skies. 
Auto Headlights: Introducing the Auto Headlights feature! Now, when darkness falls, your vehicle's headlights will automatically illuminate the road ahead, enhancing visibility and immersion. This feature can be enabled or disabled from the pause menu.
Tire Mark Visuals: we've enhanced the visual representation of tire marks in the game, adding more realism and detail to the racing experience.  
Destructible Objects: We've given a complete makeover to destructible objects within the game. Say goodbye to simple, bland destruction.
Burnout: Improved Burnout system to be more natural.    


Bug Fixes
Fix issue with visuals in chase gamemode. 
Fixed issue with mini map not showing updated map.
Fixed issue where some activities weren't spawning in. 
Fixed issue where car would not take damage upside down.
Fixed issue when driving the car could spin randomly after hitting a small bump.
Fix issue in shops where the item you tried to equip would make the selection move to the left or right.
Fix issue where your car could spawn with skid marks in the air.
Fixed issue with respawn carrying over forces when hitting a wall. 
Fixed issue with destructibles duplicating and causing lag.
Fixed issue where ai was falling under map on the market.
Fixed issue where the burnout sound was playing infinite.
Improved navigation in all races to reduce lag.
Improved race position not updating fast enough. 
Fixed issue where you couldn't turn camera in air. 
Fixed memory leak for quests. 
Fixed race Automatic.
Fixed navigation for shops.
Improved Headlights and rear lights.
Fixed issues with first person camera, clipping and going inside the car.
Improved F5 and shockwave Landing.
Fixed issue with matchmaking throbber. 
Fixed lighting issues in the car select and main menu.
Improved Burnout system to be more natural. 
Fixed issue where the player could spawn under map in races
Fixed issue where players were teleported to random locations in the slums from jump. 
Fixed issue where players could get DNF even when going over the finish line.
Fixed issue where burnout was not resetting speed. 
Fixed issue where you couldn’t open the big map. 
Fixed navigation on the quest tab.
Fixed issues where race barriers not lining up with the map.
Fixed issue with tires sticking out too much on some vehicles.     
Fixed issue where traffic lights would fall through the ground after hitting them.

notes.title: Maximum Velocity Update 0.1.2.4
notes.notes:
Maximum Velocity Update 0.1.2.4

June 30th, 2023

Rev up your engines Gladiators and get ready to race with the latest update of Maximum Velocity! Here's what's in store:

New Features:

Race overlap UI redesigned, providing comprehensive information about ongoing activity.
Construction site revamped for an immersive gameplay environment.
Prepare for chaos with newly added destructible elements throughout the city.
Sleek redesign of F5 tail lights, adding a touch of style to your ride.
Spot the cops easily with the introduction of an icon during high-speed chases.
Immerse yourself in the action with cinematic camera movements.
Enhanced vehicle audio for an authentic racing experience.
Transit replaced with the thrilling Gridlock Rank challenge.
Improved traffic collision mechanics.
Backend infrastructure upgrades to enhance the racing experience.
Automatic inclusion reintroduced for seamless race participation.
Fine-tuned physics for destructible objects, adding more realism to crashes.
Streamlined UI placement for point accumulation in the Chase game mode.

Bug Fixes:

No more false DNF notifications when crossing the finish line.
Burnout issues resolved, ensuring consistent speed boosts.
Boost functionality fixed for maximum turbocharged action.
Burnout issues resolved upon player death.
Camera won't go below the map when flipped upside down.
Becoming a cop before the match starts is now a thing of the past.
Smooth city entry with parts loading smoothly.
Sparks spawn correctly when colliding with objects.
Camera behavior refined for downhill sections.
Landscape glitches fixed to prevent car flipping.
